subsecond_register_update_frequency.title: Subsecond register update frequency
subsecond_register_update_frequency.description: Subsecond register update frequency is indicative. You can modify the asynchronous prescaler factor to change it.

synchronous_predivider_value.title: Synchronous prescaler factor
synchronous_predivider_value.description: Synchronous prescaler factor value must be between 1 and 32768.

bcd_seconds_increment.title: BCD update
bcd_seconds_increment.description: Selects the condition to increment the calendar second in BCD and MIX modes, or the wakeup timer in MIX and BINARY modes.

attributes.description: The calendar second is incremented based on the subsecond register value SSR[]. The wakeup timer can also be incremented the same way when its input is configured accordingly.
The wakeup timer can be incremented based on the subsecond register value SSR[] when its input is configured accordingly.
BCD update frequency is indicative. You can modify both the synchronous and asynchronous prescaler factors to change it. To use the calendar, this value must be 1 Hz.
In binary mode, the BCD update frequency is the increment frequency of the wake-up timer when it is clocked by the SSR[].
BCD update frequency is indicative. You can modify both the asynchronous prescaler factor and bcd update to change it.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Calendar is not functional in binary mode.

shadow_register.description: Values can be taken from the shadow register, which are update once every two RTCCLK cycles.

reference_clock_detection.title: Reference clock detection
reference_clock_detection.description: Only works when RTC is set to BCD mode only.

sub_seconds.title: Sub seconds
sub_seconds.description: Sub seconds is compared with the contents of the synchronous prescaler factor. You must adjust the mask sub seconds parameter to select the number of least-significant bits used in the comparison. Sub seconds value must be between 0 and synchronous prescaler factor - 1.

flag_auto_clear.title: Flag auto clear
flag_auto_clear.description: Alarm A flag is automatically cleared by hardware or must be cleared by software to allow next alarm event.

mask_sub_seconds.title: Mask sub seconds
mask_sub_seconds.description: Values between 0 and 15 specify how many least-significant subsecond bits are compared for alarm A.

free_running_32_bits_value.title: Free running 32 bits value
free_running_32_bits_value.description: Value must be between 0 and 0xFFFF FFFF. You must adjust the free running 32 bits mask parameter to select the number of least-significant bits used in the comparison.

computed.const: ($additional.alarm_a.free_running_32_bits_value / ($basic.clock_frequency / $basic.asynchronous_predivider_value)) >= 3600 ? Math.floor(($additional.alarm_a.free_running_32_bits_value / ($basic.clock_frequency / $basic.asynchronous_predivider_value)) / 3600) + ' h ' + Math.floor((($additional.alarm_a.free_running_32_bits_value / ($basic.clock_frequency / $basic.asynchronous_predivider_value)) % 3600) / 60) + ' min ' + (($additional.alarm_a.free_running_32_bits_value / ($basic.clock_frequency / $basic.asynchronous_predivider_value)) % 60).toFixed(3) + ' s' : ($additional.alarm_a.free_running_32_bits_value / ($basic.clock_frequency / $basic.asynchronous_predivider_value)) >= 60 ? Math.floor(($additional.alarm_a.free_running_32_bits_value / ($basic.clock_frequency / $basic.asynchronous_predivider_value)) / 60) + ' min ' + (($additional.alarm_a.free_running_32_bits_value / ($basic.clock_frequency / $basic.asynchronous_predivider_value)) % 60).toFixed(3) + ' s' : ($additional.alarm_a.free_running_32_bits_value / ($basic.clock_frequency / $basic.asynchronous_predivider_value)) >= 1 ? ($additional.alarm_a.free_running_32_bits_value / ($basic.clock_frequency / $basic.asynchronous_predivider_value)).toFixed(3) + ' s' : ($additional.alarm_a.free_running_32_bits_value / ($basic.clock_frequency / $basic.asynchronous_predivider_value)) >= 0.001 ? (($additional.alarm_a.free_running_32_bits_value / ($basic.clock_frequency / $basic.asynchronous_predivider_value)) * 1000).toFixed(3) + ' ms' : (($additional.alarm_a.free_running_32_bits_value / ($basic.clock_frequency / $basic.asynchronous_predivider_value)) * 1000000).toFixed(3) + ' us'

wake_up_divider.title: Wake up divider
wake_up_divider.description: RTCCLK is divided by (PREDIV_A+1)*(PREDIV_S+1). To have 1 Hz period, with the LSE clock (RTCCLK = 32768 Hz), PREDIV_A can be equal to 127 and PREDIV_S can be equal to 255.

attributes.description: Number of periods before wake up. Value must be between 1 and 65535. With a divider 2, wake up counter cannot be equal to 0. The minimum wake up time is 122us.
Number of periods before wake up. Value must be between 0 and 65535.
Number of periods before wake up. Value must be between 65536 and 131071.

computed.const: ($additional.wake_up.wake_up_minimum_period * ($additional.wake_up.wake_up_counter + 1)) >= 3600 ? Math.floor(($additional.wake_up.wake_up_minimum_period * ($additional.wake_up.wake_up_counter + 1)) / 3600) + ' h ' + Math.floor((($additional.wake_up.wake_up_minimum_period * ($additional.wake_up.wake_up_counter + 1)) % 3600) / 60) + ' min ' + (($additional.wake_up.wake_up_minimum_period * ($additional.wake_up.wake_up_counter + 1)) % 60).toFixed(3) + ' s' : ($additional.wake_up.wake_up_minimum_period * ($additional.wake_up.wake_up_counter + 1)) >= 60 ? Math.floor(($additional.wake_up.wake_up_minimum_period * ($additional.wake_up.wake_up_counter + 1)) / 60) + ' min ' + (($additional.wake_up.wake_up_minimum_period * ($additional.wake_up.wake_up_counter + 1)) % 60).toFixed(3) + ' s' : ($additional.wake_up.wake_up_minimum_period * ($additional.wake_up.wake_up_counter + 1)).toFixed(3) + ' s'

auto_clear.title: Wake-up flag auto clear
auto_clear.description: If auto-clear is disable, flag must be cleared by the software. Otherwise, WUTF will be automatically cleared by the hardware at clear flag time after wake up time.

actions.message: When wake-up counter is equal to 0, wake-up flag must be cleared by software. Disable this parameter or modify wake-up counter value.
When wake-up counter is equal to 65536 in BCD update 17 bits, wake-up flag must be cleared by software. Disable this parameter or modify wake-up counter value.

attributes.description: WUTF will be automatically cleared by the hardware at clear flag time after wake up time. Value must be between 1 and wake up counter.

actions.message: Clear flag counter must be between 1 and wake up counter.
